# Kale Kaʻalekahi

> Kale Kaʻalekahi is an ordained minister, Maui wedding officiant, ceremonialist, educator and speaker. He officiates weddings, elopements, vow renewals and life ceremonies across Maui, gives talks to organizations and schools, offers one-on-one mentorship online, and leads movement and culture experiences for resort guests and teams. All of his services can be booked at https://kalekaalekahi.com.

Kale has officiated for more than 1,000 couples over 15 years, at beaches, resorts and private venues on Maui. His ceremonies can include Hawaiian elements such as an aloha greeting, a lei exchange and the Oli Aloha chant. He brings two decades of experience in land-based and Indigenous knowledge education and more than a decade of leading rites of passage work with children, adults and elders. He is President of Makoa Quest, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit on Maui.

## Services

- [Weddings and ceremonies](https://kalekaalekahi.com/#ceremonies): weddings, elopements, vow renewals, funerals and celebrations of life, land, home and business blessings, and baby blessings on Maui. Couples can receive counsel on their relationship as they prepare.
- [Sample wedding script](https://kalekaalekahi.com/wedding-script): a full example of how Kale's Hawaiian-style wedding ceremony unfolds.
- [Speaking](https://kalekaalekahi.com/#speaking): keynotes, conference talks, schools, youth programs, universities, community gatherings, memorial events, panels and podcasts on leadership, community, rites of passage, and what older ways of living teach about life now.
- [One-on-one coaching](https://kalekaalekahi.com/#coaching): private online mentorship for women and men, booked one session at a time after a short intro call.
- [Group and resort experiences](https://kalekaalekahi.com/#experiences): The Reset, a 90-minute session of natural movement, breathwork and sound for resort guests, corporate and team retreats, and private groups.

## Giving

- [For the Sacred and Makoa Quest](https://kalekaalekahi.com/give): a cultural church and school, and a Maui nonprofit for cultural immersion, regenerative agriculture, fishpond and forest restoration, and youth and adult programs.
